led.title: LED Settings
led.content:
LED & NFC-LED Hardware Settings.

  • Connected LED-Type.
  • LED color order corresponding to the LED type

Here you can configure the LEDs for the sample.

  • Number of LEDs: Number of WS2812b LEDs, corresponding to the number of planned samples
  • Brightness: The brightness for the sample LEDs (0–100%)
  • LED Color: The color that lights up above the detected sample
  • LED Color on Error: The color displayed when the NFC tag is unknown
  • Pulsing LED Color: The color that pulses in standby mode
  • Timeout: How many milliseconds the LED should light up on the sample

nfcled.title: NFC LED Settings
nfcled.content:
Here you can configure the NFC LEDs, which light up the NFC symbol (default 12).

  • Number of LEDs: Number of WS2812b LEDs
  • Brightness: The brightness for the NFC LEDs (0–100%)
  • LED Color (NFC detected): The color displayed when an NFC tag is detected
  • LED Color (NFC Error): The color displayed when the NFC tag is unknown
  • LED Timeout (ms): How long the LEDs light up when an NFC tag is detected
  • Pulsing LED Color (Standby): The color that pulses in standby mode
  • Blinking: Whether the LEDs should blink on NFC interaction
  • Blink Count: Number of blink cycles
  • Blink Interval (ms): Interval between blink cycles

mqtt.title: MQTT Settings
mqtt.content:
MQTT connection to the broker.

  • Broker IP or hostname
  • Client ID should be unique
  • Discovery enables automatic HA integration

button.title: Pushbutton Settings
button.content:
Configure the pushbutton including debounce and multi-click detection.

  • Pull-Up active: enable internal pull-up (active-low)
  • Debounce (ms): Time in milliseconds to wait for a stable input
  • Long Press (ms): Time in milliseconds the button must be pressed to count as a long press
  • Double Press Gap (ms): Time in milliseconds between two clicks to detect a double press
  • Hold Repeat (ms): Interval in milliseconds for repeating action while the button is held

buzzer.title: Buzzer Settings
buzzer.content:
Configure the piezo buzzer, e.g., volume and pitch.

  • Active-High Output: Whether the output is active-high (true) or active-low (false)
  • Frequency (Hz): The frequency of the buzzer in Hertz
  • Single Beep On (ms): Duration of a single beep
  • Double Beep On (ms): Duration of a double beep
  • Double Beep Gap (ms): Interval in milliseconds between the two beeps of a double beep
  • Error Beep On (ms): Duration of an error beep
  • Error Beep Gap (ms): Interval in milliseconds between error beeps
  • Error Beep Count: Number of beeps on error

dashboard.title: Dashboard Settings
dashboard.content:
General settings for the dashboard.

  • Highlight LED Timeout (ms): Time the LEDs of the samples light up when a sample or filter is clicked in the web interface.
  • Color theme for the web interface (light/dark)
  • Language: English, German

importexport.title: Import / Export Settings
importexport.content:
Here you can export and import the complete configuration.

    The configuration is saved in JSON format and can be edited with a text editor.

debug.title: Debug Settings
debug.content: Enable debug for the web console and serial interface.

info.title: Info Settings
info.content: Displays information about the device, e.g., version, memory usage, and hardware details.

update.title: Update
update.content:
Here you can perform firmware updates.

  • Select a valid .bin file that is compatible with this device.
  • Click 'Start Update' to begin the update process.
  • The device will automatically reboot when the update is complete.
